content.short: Travessia Credit brings private credit exposure onchain as a tokenized real-world asset.
content.description: Travessia Credit connects institutional lenders with businesses that need working capital against verified invoices, built specifically around global trade flows. Originators onboard through institutional partners and draw on invoice-backed facilities. Capital providers allocate into structured, invoice-backed opportunities with institutional controls and real-time visibility into the underlying receivables. Both sides operate on the same platform, with the credit itself tokenized on Monad.
content.meta: Private credit returns generated outside crypto, tokenized on Monad.
